ABOUT NEXA

Practical Expertise. Reliable Support. Better Business Decisions.

NEXA Advisory & Consulting Pvt. Ltd. supports businesses with accounting, taxation, financial reporting, corporate compliance and business advisory services, using practical solutions, structured processes and a client-focused approach.

  • Client-focused: your priorities come first.

FAQS

Common Questions.

All FAQs
What services does NEXA provide?

NEXA supports businesses with accounting, taxation, financial reporting, corporate compliance, payroll and HR support, business advisory, project finance documentation and outsourced finance support.

How do I start an engagement?

Book a meeting online or send an enquiry through the contact page. After an initial discussion we agree scope and deliverables in writing before any work begins.

Can I book a meeting online?

Yes. Choose a physical, group or one-on-one meeting on the Book a Meeting page and pick a time that suits you.

What documents will I need to provide?

It depends on the service. Typically bank statements, invoices, prior accounts and registration details. The booking page has a checklist, and we confirm the list after an initial discussion.

Do you support clients in Nepal and internationally?

Yes. We serve clients all over Nepal and globally, and international clients are supported remotely.

How are scope and timelines decided?

We agree deliverables, responsibilities and timelines in writing before work begins. Changes are made by agreement.
